diagnosis: Customer reports a ~1-hour gap in webhook deliveries (14:00–15:00 yesterday) with ~40 missed events. reply: Thank you for reporting the missed webhook events. Our system automatically retries failed deliveries up to six times over an hour, after which events become available for manual replay for seven days. I’ve checked the logs for your account and don’t see a regional outage during that window, but I’ll confirm whether the events are still retrievable for replay. Could you share the approximate timestamp of the first missed event (e.g., 14:00:00) to help locate them?
